title: Manifest
description: Top-level config-as-code desired state for an instance (CFG-002).

apiVersion.description: API version of this instance manifest.

metadata.description: Identity and optional labels or annotations for this manifest.

spec.description: The instance identity, reusable external connections, and active gaggles.

instance.description: Identity of the deployed Goobers instance configured by this manifest.

environment.description: Deployment environment represented by this independently deployed instance.

connections.description: Named reusable links to external systems that gaggles and goobers may reference.

gaggles.description: Names of gaggle definitions included in this instance's desired state.

metadata.description: Deliberately left open (no additionalProperties:false) unlike the rest of this schema: k8s-style metadata objects tolerate forward-compatible extra fields (e.g. a future resourceVersion) by convention (#125).

labels.description: String labels used to organize this manifest.

annotations.description: Non-identifying string metadata attached to this manifest.

name.description: Name used by gaggles and goobers to reference this connection.

type.description: Category of external system this connection links to.

provider.description: Backing vendor or service, such as github, ado, azure-adx, or entra.

secretRef.description: Reference to the credentials used for this connection.

endpoint.description: Optional service endpoint or host override.

key.description: Optional field selected from the referenced secret.

keyVault.description: Optional Key Vault containing the secret; omit to use the gaggle's default vault.
